fusions.name: Reef-Cut Fester
fusions.desc: A grazing sting that deals 4 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds, with a 30% chance to leave it [Diseased] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Branching Colony
fusions.desc: A cone 4 tiles long that deals 11 damage to everything in it, with a 50% chance to leave each target [Poisoned] for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each target spread to enemies within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Budding Outpost
fusions.desc: Roots a colony head where you stand for 12 seconds. Every second it stings an enemy within 4 tiles and deals 3 damage, with a 30% chance to leave the target [Poisoned] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Slow Regrowth
fusions.desc: Every time you dodge a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you are healed for 5% of your maximum health per stack (25% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
